description: Liu Bei, dignified chinese lord in the supplied pixel art style. Black hair in a topknot with a small gold crown, long green cape with gold shoulder plates, white and gold robe over armor, dark boots. He holds a straight sword in each hand
face: Kind steady eyes, a thin black moustache and a short beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: black hair with the gold crown, the long green cape with gold shoulder plates covering the back, a sword at each side.
guard_action: both hands lift their weapons up in front of the body, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Twin-weapon fighting guard, one weapon in each hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place with a weapon in each hand, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Two cuts, right then left. Frames 1-5 wind up; frame 7 the right weapon cuts; frame 9 the left weapon cuts; frames 10-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin swords stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Rising right-hand cut, left weapon blocking low. Frames 1-5 the right weapon drops low; frame 8 it cuts upward while the left weapon guards low; frames 9-11 finish high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin swords stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Leaping double downward cut. Frames 1-4 crouch; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground with both weapons raised; frame 8 he lands cutting down with both; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin swords stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s1: Benevolent rally. Frames 1-6 both weapons are lowered and gathered in front; frame 8 he lifts both weapons up and outward in an open raising gesture; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin swords stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.c4: Rising double cut from a low hidden guard. Both weapons are held low behind the body, the knees bend, and they are cut upward through the target one after the other as the body rises; they finish high.
actions.c5: Block and counter. One weapon is raised to block in front of the body; the other cuts across the target in a wide arc straight after; a short hold.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a2 → b3, 전법 s1. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
